title: Laryngotomy
summary: LARYNGOT'OMY, noun [larynx and Gr. to cut.] The operation of cutting the larynx or windpipe; the making of an incision into the larynx for assisting respiration when obstructed, or removing foreign bo

inlines.v: LARYNGOT'OMY, noun [larynx and Gr. to cut.] The operation of cutting the larynx or windpipe; the making of an incision into the larynx for assisting respiration when obstructed, or removing foreign bodies; bronchotomy; tracheotomy.
